name: io.creativeforesight/foresight-api
title: Foresight API
description: Economic, demographic and financial time series, plus Creative Foresight indicators and signals.

tools.name: search_indicators
tools.description: Search Foresight API economic, demographic, and derived (cf:) indicators. Returns matching indicator codes, descriptions, units, source slugs, and frequencies. Creative Foresight originals use cf:* codes and region filters use FIPS-style region codes where applicable.

query.description: Search text for indicator names or descriptions.

source.description: Optional source slug such as fred, bls, bea, or cf.

tools.name: list_sources
tools.description: List Foresight API sources and catalog freshness context for economic, demographic, and derived cf:* indicators.

tools.name: list_regions
tools.description: List supported API regions. County and subnational regions use FIPS-style codes that can be passed to observation tools.

type.description: Optional region type filter, such as country, state, or county.

tools.name: get_observations
tools.description: Return an authenticated time series for an economic, demographic, or derived Creative Foresight cf:* indicator, optionally filtered by FIPS-style region code and date range. Includes unit and attribution metadata from the v1 observations API.

indicator.description: Indicator code, including Creative Foresight originals such as cf:* codes.

region.description: Optional region code. County regions use FIPS codes.

start_date.description: Optional inclusive start date as YYYY-MM-DD.

end_date.description: Optional inclusive end date as YYYY-MM-DD.

as_of.description: Optional YYYY-MM-DD: read the values as published by the end of that day, never a later revision (point-in-time, for backtests without look-ahead).

tools.name: get_latest
tools.description: Return the latest authenticated value for an economic, demographic, or derived Creative Foresight cf:* indicator, optionally filtered by FIPS-style region code. Use this when an agent needs the current value rather than a full series.

indicator.description: Indicator code, including Creative Foresight originals such as cf:* codes.

region.description: Optional region code. County regions use FIPS codes.

as_of.description: Optional YYYY-MM-DD: read the values as published by the end of that day, never a later revision (point-in-time, for backtests without look-ahead).

tools.name: get_insights
tools.description: Return deterministic computed facts for one indicator plus active signals. Every fact and signal carries a server-rendered, shareable plain-spoken sentence in `text` (null when the indicator lacks curated display metadata). Facts also include humanTemplate, typed params, and salience scores from 0..1. Signals include strength, direction, salience, evidence, and glyph, friendly direction-aware label, plus tone vocabulary for UI chips.

indicator.description: Indicator code, including Creative Foresight originals such as cf:* codes.

region.description: Optional region code. County regions use FIPS codes.

source.description: Optional source slug for duplicate provider codes.

window.description: Observation window: all, or an integer followed by d, m, or y, such as 90d, 12m, or 5y.

tools.name: get_active_signals
tools.description: Return active Creative Foresight signal intervals across indicators. Each result carries a server-rendered, shareable plain-spoken sentence in `text`, plus type, strength, direction, interval timestamps, detector evidence, and glyph, friendly direction-aware label, plus tone vocabulary for UI chips. Requires premium creative-foresight API-key access.

indicators.description: Optional indicator codes, including Creative Foresight originals such as cf:* codes.

region.description: Optional region code. County regions use FIPS codes.

strength.description: Minimum signal strength. Defaults to neutral, hiding weak signals.

tools.name: ask
tools.description: Ask a natural-language question over Foresight data and get a grounded answer with a verifiable citation trace. Every number in the prose traces to an executed tool call listed in citations; resolved names the indicators, regions, and window the question mapped to. Questions with no Foresight coverage return no_coverage and are never charged. Prefer this tool when you do not know the indicator vocabulary; use the typed tools when you do.

question.description: A natural-language question about economic, demographic, or financial data.

region.description: Optional FIPS region hint: 5-digit county, 2-digit state, or US.

window.description: Optional observation window: all, or an integer followed by d, m, or y, such as 90d, 12m, or 5y.
